name: Culture Amp
summary: Culture Amp sells Perform, its performance product, by quote only. Its pricing page publishes no prices and says cost depends on headcount, product and service tier. All products are billed annually, and service tiers split at 200 and 1,000 employees.

facts.text: Culture Amp's pricing page says all products are billed annually and that pricing depends on the number of employees, the product and the service tier.
The pricing page states full GDPR and SOC 2 compliance and says SSO, encryption and HRIS integrations come with every plan.
Goals can be pulled into manager reviews and self-reflections only for individual and individual development goals, and only while a cycle is in draft.
Culture Amp prefers to call its surveys confidential rather than anonymous. Results are reported in aggregate, and the minimum reporting group size is usually 5.

Its pre-launch checklist recommends a minimum reporting group of 3 for smaller organizations and 5 for medium to large ones, and says demographic data is copied into a survey at launch and does not update afterward.
On the pricing page, Engage has a "Request a quote" option and no price. All products are billed annually.

hiddenCosts: Service tiers differ by headcount: under 200, 200 to 999, and 1,000 or more employees.
People Science Consulting is an add-on quoted separately.
